messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: RStan 2.6.0 install script fixed
parts:
Hi all,

There is an incompatibility with RStan 2.6.0 and the new BH package (1.58.0) on CRAN. Ben fixed the install script and there shouldn't be issues installing RStan 2.6.0 now. If you have any problems, please reach out.

We're still working on the next release and we will have 2.7.0 available soon.


- Stan Development Team

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: RStan 2.6.0 install script fixed
parts:
On Thursday, June 4, 2015 at 2:59:22 PM UTC-4, Phil Price wrote:
Same problem. I've attached the entire R console log.

This is due to having Boost >= 1.56 in /usr/local/include and CRAN for Mac automatically adding /usr/local/include to the search path. Perhaps the easiest workaround is to temporarily rename /usr/local/include/boost to /usr/local/include/Boost or something while running install_rstan().

Ben

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan 2.6.0 install script fixed

Jiqiang is right: Mac's file system, by default, is not case sensitive, so you'll have to change it to something else.

I just verified that this occurs when there's a Boost version that's greater than 1.55 on the system. I installed boost using brew (brew install boost). That prevented RStan from installing. By clearing out Boost (brew rm boost), I was able to install RStan.

Can you see if moving / removing Boost fixes the install problem for you?



Daniel
